title: Replace landing page with direct login and enable Google sign-in
description: Hilangkan landing page, arahkan root langsung ke login, redesign halaman login mengikuti referensi visual yang diberikan, dan aktifkan Better Auth Google sign-in.
notes: Root path harus langsung ke login, tanpa landing page.
Desain login harus mendekati reference glassmorphism dark card.
Provider Google harus aktif lewat Better Auth dan tombol login harus terhubung.
completionDetails: Added Better Auth magic link and reset-password flows, disabled self sign-up, and moved the email login button below the fields for clearer sign-in UX.
